completionStandard: DORAPP country research completion means every required discovery category has been explicitly reviewed, all strong candidates have been resolved to canonical/rejected/insufficient-evidence status, canonical entities have evidence and routes, derived counts validate, source-health runs, and production deploy succeeds.
sourceClassesReviewed: Hollandiai Magyar Szövetség national umbrella directory and annual publications
notes: The map organization count intentionally includes civil/community groups and official/institutional organizations, while child activities are excluded.
HYA Netherlands and MaFi are retained as distinct youth/student networks because current evidence describes separate network identities.
Mikes International is modeled separately from the Hollandiai Mikes Kelemen Kör because it is a separately registered publishing foundation with its own publication and digital-library layer.
Vianen is modeled as a separate current congregation under the Zwollei Hungarian Reformed congregation because 2026 service schedules explicitly identify it as a distinct local worship community.
Stichting Magyar Nóta is included as a current Dutch cultural foundation dedicated to preserving and programming Hungarian musical heritage.
Hollandiai Magyarok Gyülekezete (HMGY) is included as a current Hungarian-language Rotterdam congregation supported by Dutch institutional directories and current web-archive evidence.
Routine weekend-school sessions are not promoted into the public event calendar; only explicitly named public/community events qualify.
Historical federation-list entities without sufficient current evidence remain discovery-only rather than being carried forward automatically.
